searchText: On the last eof call the consensus was to try to roll out eof devnet on top of pectra. Could EL client teams please confirm which branches we should be using to test EOF-devnet-0? What would be the way to activate EOF on geth/besu/nethermind? <@827653956955406406> <@403707149043105803> <@360491619402776577> <@758579010027782144> <@628018527470616606> <@877270907314372629> <@519796549279023105> cc <@429719902363058177> Basu and reth and closest to having functional devnet. For other teams this is still wip. reth uses the geth style genesis.json for initalizing a network. What value do you use to trigger EOF ? It is currently set for Prague, but in next days would introduce PragueEOF to saparate it from devnet-1 ok something like this then? ``` ... "shanghaiTime": 0, "cancunTime": 0, "pragueTime": (infinity), "pragueEOFTime": <configured> ... ``` In Reth, Enabling PragueEOF will enable Prague and all other EIPs. Linking discussion for making EOF use EIPs on top of devnet-1: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/892088344438255616/1250412102288408577 While we have you here, also respond to the prague discussion as well: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/892088344438255616/1252277408044683294 so if we wanna enable `pragueEOFTime` then it must match `pragueTime` ? <@360491619402776577> could you add support to the same flag name in geth then ? <@814151075601973278> could you please add support to the same flag in erigon? Besu doesn't have to have the "PragueTime" entry if the "PragueEOFTime" entry exists. The presence of the "PragueEOFTime" entry implies that all prior forks not enumerated are enabled at that time, and Prague is prior to PragueEOF. I would like to keep is as uniform as possible, so will most likely use the same format for besu / geth genesis btw when will besu be able ot read geth style genesis.json? 😄 There are differences with Geth style genesis. We are close, but we haven't taken it as a requirement to read Geth's genesis. its not a requirement, it would be a nice to have going forward Noted I just realized that we need to upstream a bunch of pectra stuff first, will try to get that done within the next week or so and then provide a version with `pragueEOFTime` cc: <@1011612262743679036> 😉

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content:
On the last eof call the consensus was to try to roll out eof devnet on top of pectra. 

Could EL client teams please confirm which branches we should be using to test EOF-devnet-0? 
What would be the way to activate EOF on geth/besu/nethermind?

excerpts.author: draganrakita
excerpts.content: Basu and reth and closest to having functional devnet. For other teams this is still wip.

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: reth uses the geth style genesis.json for initalizing a network. What value do you use to trigger EOF ?

excerpts.author: draganrakita
excerpts.content: It is currently set for Prague, but in next days would introduce PragueEOF to saparate it from devnet-1

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: ok

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content:
something like this then? 
```
... 
"shanghaiTime": 0,
"cancunTime": 0,
"pragueTime": (infinity),
"pragueEOFTime": <configured>
...
```

excerpts.author: draganrakita
excerpts.content: In Reth, Enabling PragueEOF will enable Prague and all other EIPs. Linking discussion for making EOF use EIPs on top of devnet-1: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/892088344438255616/1250412102288408577

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content: While we have you here, also respond to the prague discussion as well: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/892088344438255616/1252277408044683294

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: so if we wanna enable `pragueEOFTime` then it must match `pragueTime` ?

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: <@360491619402776577> could you add support to the same flag name in geth then ?

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: <@814151075601973278> could you please add support to the same flag in erigon?

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: Besu doesn't have to have the "PragueTime" entry if the "PragueEOFTime" entry exists.  The presence of the "PragueEOFTime" entry implies that all prior forks not enumerated are enabled at that time, and Prague is prior to PragueEOF.

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: I would like to keep is as uniform as possible, so will most likely use the same format for besu / geth genesis

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: btw when will besu be able ot read geth style genesis.json? 😄

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: There are differences with Geth style genesis.  We are close, but we haven't taken it as a requirement to read Geth's genesis.

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: its not a requirement, it would be a nice to have going forward

excerpts.author: matt.nelson
excerpts.content: Noted

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: I just realized that we need to upstream a bunch of pectra stuff first, will try to get that done within the next week or so and then provide a version with `pragueEOFTime`
